content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. Thank you for sending over the contract. I have one small item to review before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, the agreement states that intellectual property is owned by the client during the project, meaning ownership passes before you receive full payment. We propose the following modification: Ownership of all Intellectual Property created under this Agreement shall remain with the Contractor and shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment. Please let me know your thoughts on this update. Best regards,
